source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_systemHealth" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i health (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the system health OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_systemHealth SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve BMC system-health objects through SNMPv3 and confirm their semantic values.
original_method: Engineer enables SNMPv3/account in WebUI and uses IReasoning on `$target`; Criteria instead name Net-SNMP without defining that target.
manual_activity: After correction, engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3; automated SNMP collection and comparison can perform the evidence phase.
required_inputs: Vendor MIB/version and exact health OIDs
safety_requirements: Use least-privilege SNMPv3; protect auth/privacy secrets.
Do not substitute v2c or a generic enterprise subtree.
Do not treat successful retrieval as healthy status.
Restore account/agent state; no auto retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, run exact SNMPv3 GET/WALK, preserve typed values and compare to baseline/cross-check.
Do not operate WebUI or decide verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Wrong security mode, generic OID and grep cannot prove vendor system health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor MIB-resolved exact SNMPv3 objects with full typed output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map health summary and contributing state OIDs, query with SNMPv3, validate enums and correlate with independent BMC health.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, MIB and client versions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves semantic health rather than transport only.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aggregate health may lag component faults.

project_override_considerations: Client may be IReasoning or Net-SNMP if the same v3 objects and typed values are preserved.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure specifies IReasoning/SNMPv3, Criteria switch to Net-SNMP, `$target` is unresolved, and DeepSeek changes to v2c/generic OID.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Health OIDs/enums are required project inputs. After an engineer configures SNMPv3, the core read and comparison can be automated.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE under V3.1; missing OIDs are inputs and WebUI configuration is manual setup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Allows either client after canonical objects exist.

review_improvement: Requires semantic health enums and independent correlation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Transport success alone says nothing about health, but an approved target/enum contract makes the core query automated. Manual BMC setup makes this PARTIAL.
